steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: L.G.D.'s escort team has managed to leave safely.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But... it doesn't look like our enemies have any intention on letting us go.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As long as they don't know that Misha has left with the L.G.D., they'll continue to focus their efforts on us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha will be safer this way.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Now that I think about it, why are both Reunion and Lungmen after this kid?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't say for sure. There are a lot of possibilities.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My best guess is that either she, or something she knows, is significant enough to determine Lungmen's continued safety.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Something?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, perhaps some intel or information...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So that's why both Lungmen and Reunion are after her.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What a dangerous contest...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And none of us can stay out of it, not us, Misha, or the L.G.D.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hopefully we don't end up caught in the crossfire.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We don't know anything, but we have to take care of everything...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I, I'm not quite sure...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But as for Madam Ch'en...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have a hunch... that things aren't going to end so smoothly.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Amiya, is there anything left for us to do?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Should we accompany you back to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No thank you. Nothing is holding us back in combat anymore, so we should be fine.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If that's the case, we'll head back and wait for further orders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Moving forward, I hope you'll continue to keep an eye out on Reunion's movements within Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though we've handed Misha over to the L.G.D., the fact that Reunion is here... still makes me uneasy.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Easily done~ We'll be on our way now~

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm. I'll leave you to it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, we don't know how many more Reunion members there are in hiding.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Make sure to stay prepared and alert.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Next, we'll continue to relocate our operations within these high-rises.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If necessary, we can even use the rooftops.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This way, we'll have a terrain advantage versus having to fight Reunion out in the streets.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If necessary, we'll draw them towards areas that we control!

steps.name: Operators
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Talulah.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The preparations are complete.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's time to make our move.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: --Speak.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: There actually is a strategic purpose for us to attack Lungmen.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If we can take control of Lungmen, Reunion will have a huge advantage.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Of course, this comes with a high risk.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...Why are you preoccupied with this idea?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Do you see that structure over there?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I see it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's the symbol of Lungmen... It's also...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I didn't come back here just to return everything that has been taken from the Infected.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I will also... make him pay.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Above all... Don't you think that... things are getting very interesting?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Don't you agree... Talulah?
